description.subtitle: T-shirt Puma del Stade Rennais Edition 125th anniversary - red
description.tagline: Historia y orgullo en cada detalle
description.intro: The 125th anniversary Puma Stade Rennais T-shirt pays tribute to the club’s history with an exclusive design full of meaning. Inspired by the team’s legacy, it incorporates references to its 125 years and its great legends.
key_benefits: Special edition 125th anniversary: Commemorative design celebrating the history of the club.
Recycled jacquard fabric: Provide premium texture and sustainability.
DryCELL technology: Evacuate sweat to keep skin dry and comfortable.
Exclusive design: Includes graphic references to historical players.
Confort ligero: Ideal para uso diario o animar a tu equipo.
